writeup.headline: Palantir rates Buy: exceptional growth, margins and net cash offset by a very high absolute valuation.
writeup.thesis: Palantir scores 70, a Buy, because its business numbers are outstanding while its valuation is the main drag. Growth scores 98 on latest-quarter revenue growth of 92.8% year on year and TTM revenue growth of 78.9%, and growth sped up by 8.1 pp from the previous quarter. Quality (86) and balance sheet (100) are also strong, with an 84.8% gross margin, a 42.8% operating margin, a 54.5% FCF margin, diluted share count up 0.2% year on year, and net cash with no debt. Valuation scores just 8: in absolute terms the shares are very expensive at 82.9x sales, 152.0x FCF and 190.2x EV/EBIT, with an FCF yield 4.3 pp below the 10-year Treasury yield, and the stock is expensive against its own history (EV/EBIT not comparable). Trend (82) is supportive, with the price 29.6% above its 200-day average and shares 31.7 pp ahead of SPY over the last 126 trading days, while news risk sits at 60 on broker target raises partly offset by director selling.
key_risks: Very high absolute multiples (82.9x sales, 152.0x FCF) leave little room for any growth slowdown.
Q3 results due November 2 could disappoint against raised full-year 2026 guidance.
Government contract scrutiny, including reports on uncompeted UK defence payments and France and Germany opting out of NATO's Maven system.
Revenue is about 81% U.S.-based, concentrating exposure to U.S. government and commercial spending.
Stock-based compensation at 13.6% of revenue and ongoing director selling.
what_would_change: A 10-point gain in the composite score would reach Strong Buy, most plausibly via a better valuation score if the shares fell or earnings grew into the multiples.
A drop of 6 points would push the rating to Hold, for example if growth decelerated sharply or trend weakened from its current 82.
Negative news, such as a guidance cut, analyst downgrades or lost government contracts, would pull the news risk score below 60 and could tip the rating to Hold.
